category_title: Students with low online continuity and infrequent LMS participation
scenario_title: Asynchronous LMS Engagement and Discussion Boards
minimal_context: The student is instructed to post about their weekend plans on the asynchronous discussion board and reply to peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go to the discussion board and post a few lines describing your favorite type of music or your plans for the weekend, and then respond to two or three of your peers’ postings.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I saw that assignment on the LMS, but I haven't been interacting with the online materials or the Nexos textbook very much lately.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You should try to log in and get the work done.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm struggling with it. I have significantly lower levels of participation compared to what is expected, and I'm missing a lot of on-time submissions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to catch up on the missing posts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I honestly just lack the discipline and motivation required to succeed in online learning. I've fallen completely below the minimum 50 days of activity and 45 minutes of active participation.

task.content: Post a few lines describing their favorite type of music or their plans for the weekend and then to respond to two or three of their peers’ postings
task.learning_goal: Use of the target language for display purposes

context.materials: Canvas LMS and Cengage Nexos ebook materials

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Engaging with online learning requirements in a blended environment
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Fell below the minimum in any of those variables [50 days of activity and 75% of on-time submissions, 240 and 45 minutes of passive and active participation]
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Lack the discipline, academic skills and motivation required to succeed in online learning

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Significantly lower levels of participation for all the three derived participation variables
